चुञ्चु m. (-ञ्चुः)
 1. The musk rat or shrew.
 2. A mixed caste, born of a
Brahman father by a Vaideha female.

चुञ्चुरी f. (-री) A game, a kind of hazard played with tamarind seeds in
place of dice.
 E. चुञ्च substituted for चिञ्चा the tamarind, and र from
रा to get or give, affixes ड and ङीष्, or with ल affix चुञ्चुली.
